verdict.rationale: Vercel ships a full CLI (`vercel`, `vercel deploy`, `vc`) that works non-interactively with scoped access tokens for CI, plus a REST API/SDK, webhooks for event-driven automation, and documented CI/CD-style git-push deploys — all designed for headless/automated use outside a browser. missing for 10: no explicit third-party CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions log) confirming headless auth flow end-to-end.
